items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: I didn’t do it with Stravinsky. I played Stravinsky [inaudible].

ctx.x: Yeah. You know you made me think about when I look at your resume and your list of accomplishments and things you’ve done, I wonder if there’s a difference in your mindset in your preparation and your whole demeanor from playing — I know a mutual friend mentioned that you had played “A Soldier’s Tale” — a Stravinsky.
I didn’t do it with Stravinsky. I played Stravinsky [inaudible]. There’s a recording with Syracuse Chamber Music Players that we did.
So when that’s coming up for you, even the day of it, is it a different Vince than if you’re playing with the Clark Terry Big Band? Is your head space —
